description: React component 'ActivityHeatmap' that visualizes activity patterns using a heatmap, toggling between failure rate and usage views. It processes heatmap data, computes color intensities, and renders a grid with labels, legend, and interactive buttons.

methods.name: getCellColor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a heatmap cell based on its data and current view mode ('failures' or 'usage'), utilizing different shades for visibility and intensity.

methods.name: getCellTooltip
methods.description: Generates a tooltip string showing failure counts and error rates or total executions, depending on the view mode.
